format: JavaScript (specifically test file for a JavaScript module)
description: This file contains unit tests for the auditLogger utility functions used in a front-end project. It tests functions like createAuditEntry, logFilterChange, logViewSwitch, logCsvExport, logFilterReset, and formatAuditEntry, verifying their behavior and output formats.

methods.name: createAuditEntry
methods.description: Creates an audit entry object with specified action, details, user, optional metadata, and timestamp.

methods.name: logFilterChange
methods.description: Generates an audit entry when filters are changed, recording filter changes and user info.

methods.name: logViewSwitch
methods.description: Creates an audit log entry when the user switches views, recording from and to views.

methods.name: logCsvExport
methods.description: Logs an export-to-CSV action, recording the export type, user, and record count.

methods.name: logFilterReset
methods.description: Creates an audit entry for filter reset actions by the user.

methods.name: formatAuditEntry
methods.description: Formats an audit log entry object into a string for display or logging.
